debit.sms: SMS BLOCK <Customer ID> to 5676777 (Eg: SMS BLOCK 12345678 to 5676777). If you remember your card number: SMS BLOCK <Customer ID> <Card Number> to 5676777 (Eg: SMS BLOCK 12345678 4587XXXXXXXXXXXX to 5676777).
debit.notes: 1800-22-6999 is the bank's dedicated toll-free digital-channel blocking/hotlisting hotline; phone banking is a 24x7 service with toll-free lines 1800-209-4324 and 1800-22-1070, and 022-67719100 (call charges applicable; 0091-22-67719100 from outside India) — the phone banking representative blocks the channel on request. In Internet Banking: Cards > Debit Card Hotlisting (select card number, reason, remarks, then transaction password). In the Go mobile+ app: Cards > Debit Card Hotlisting (choose card, remarks, confirm, OTP); the Abhay Card Control app also has a Card Hotlisting option. Unauthorized/fraudulent debit-card, UPI, internet- or mobile-banking transactions can also be reported and the channel blocked via www.idbibank.in > reporting of unauthorized digital transactions (unauthorisedtran.idbi.bank.in). No debit-card block email is published. The bank's pages do not mention the 1930 helpline.

credit.notes: Credit Card Customer Care for hotlisting/queries/complaints is a 24x7 service: toll-free 1800-209-4324, non-toll-free 022-67719100 (call charges applicable; +91-22-67719100 from outside India), and dedicated Credit Card Hotlisting Number 1800226999. customercare@idbi.co.in is the published email for credit-card queries. 1800 208 1947 (membersupport@idbidelight.com) is published for Delight Points reward queries only, not card blocking. No netbanking or app path for credit-card blocking is published on the bank's contact pages.

upi.notes: No bank-published self-service UPI lock; the published freeze path is the digital-channel block: for 'unauthorized/fraudulent transactions ... through any of the channels viz. debit card, UPI, internet or mobile banking', 'Call our digital channel blocking hotline 1800226999 (toll free) or phone banking numbers 18002094324 & +9122-67719100 (chargeable)' — 'The phone banking representative will block the channel as per your request'. A block request for any digital channel can also be filed via www.idbibank.in >> 'reporting of unauthorized digital transactions' (https://unauthorisedtran.idbi.bank.in/); the portal itself returned HTTP 503 on the 2026-11-01 fetch — the link is live on customer-care-centre.aspx. No netbanking UPI manage path and no in-app UPI lock/deregister path is published; the Go Mobile+ app pages document only card control/hotlisting. The bank documents the *99#/*99*49# NUUP USSD UPI channel (UPI PIN set/change/reset) but publishes no deactivate path there; SMS 'MBBLCK <Space> <Customer Id>' to 9560853000 blocks the mobile-banking service, not UPI specifically.
